scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:workers
scripts.contracts:check: npm run build -w @quant-clarity/contracts && tsx tools/generate-contracts.ts --check && redocly lint contracts/generated/openapi.json && tsx tools/check-contracts.ts
scripts.supply-chain:check: tsx tools/check-licenses.ts && npm audit --audit-level=high && npm sbom --sbom-format cyclonedx >/dev/null
scripts.test:workers: vitest run --config vitest.worker.config.ts && vitest run --config vitest.pipeline.worker.config.ts
scripts.test:web:production: QUANTCLARITY_BUILD_ENV=production QUANTCLARITY_SITE_ORIGIN=https://quantclarity.invalid npm run build -w @quant-clarity/web && QUANTCLARITY_EXPECTED_SITE_ORIGIN=https://quantclarity.invalid playwright test --config playwright.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && tsc -p tsconfig.playwright.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run cf:types:check && npm run contracts:check && npm run docs:check && npm run environments:check && npm run supply-chain:check && npm test && npm run test:workers && npm run build && npm run test:web && npm run test:web:production && npm run privacy:check
